# Hosting Service Levels

Stratocumulus Hosting GmbH (the "Provider") and Pellucid Analytics Ltd (the "Client").

## 2. Service Levels

2.1 The Provider shall ensure the Hosted Platform is Available at least 99.9% of each calendar month.

2.2 The Provider shall respond to Priority 1 incidents within 30 minutes.

2.3 The Provider shall back up Client Data daily and retain each backup for 35 days.

2.4 The Provider shall hold ISO/IEC 27001 certification.

# Monthly Service Report - October 2026

Prepared by Stratocumulus Hosting GmbH for Pellucid Analytics Ltd.

Three Priority 1 incidents were raised. All were responded to within 30 minutes; the slowest response took 19 minutes.

Daily backups completed on all 31 days. Backups are retained for 35 days.

documents.text:
# Event Catering Agreement

Between Saffron Table Catering LLP (the "Caterer") and Brightwater Conference Centre Ltd (the "Venue").

## 4. Catering Standards

4.1 The Caterer undertakes to:
(a) hold a food hygiene rating of 4 or higher throughout the Term;
(b) provide allergen information for every dish served; and
(c) remove all waste from the kitchen by 23:00 on each Event Day.

4.2 The Caterer agrees to use reasonable endeavours to source at least 50% of produce from growers located within 50 miles of the Venue.

4.3 The Venue will provide the Caterer with access to the loading bay from 07:00 on each Event Day.

## 5. Subcontracting

5.1 The Caterer shall not subcontract any part of the Services without the Venue's prior written consent.

documents.title: Statement of Work - Spring Conference Series
documents.text:
# Statement of Work - Spring Conference Series

Issued under the Event Catering Agreement between Saffron Table Catering LLP and Brightwater Conference Centre Ltd.

## Operations

- Kitchen waste will be cleared by 23:00 at the end of each Event Day.
- Every dish on the menu will be accompanied by allergen information.
- Loading bay access is available to the Caterer from 07:00 on each Event Day.

# Quarterly Quality Review Q3 2026

Reviewer: independent quality assessor appointed by Ormond & Pryce LLP.

## Findings

1. All 212 translations sampled had been reviewed by a second qualified linguist prior to delivery.
2. Certified translations were delivered in an average of 3.2 Business Days; the longest took 5 Business Days.
3. Data storage arrangements were outside the scope of this review and were not tested.

documents.title: Research Grant Agreement
documents.text:
# Research Grant Agreement

The Aldermoor Foundation (the "Funder") awards a grant to Harrowgate Institute of Marine Science (the "Grantee") on the following terms.

## 5. Use of Grant and Reporting

5.1 The Grantee shall apply the Grant solely to the Approved Project.

5.2 The Grantee shall submit an annual progress report within 60 days after each anniversary of the Start Date.

5.3 The Funder may withhold any instalment of the Grant if a progress report is overdue.

5.4 No part of the Grant may be used to fund overhead costs exceeding 15% of direct costs.

5.5 Any unspent Grant must be repaid to the Funder within 90 days of the end of the Project Period.

documents.title: Year 1 Financial and Progress Statement
documents.text:
# Year 1 Financial and Progress Statement

Submitted by Harrowgate Institute of Marine Science to The Aldermoor Foundation.

The Start Date anniversary fell on 1 June 2026. This statement and the annual progress report were submitted on 14 July 2026, 43 days after the anniversary.

Overhead costs charged to the Grant amount to 12% of direct costs.

All expenditure charged to the Grant relates to the Approved Project.
